plan: Queue midlane as primary. It is Goldilocks324's best role at 52.7% over 168 games (overall is 51.5%). Set carry as secondary, not the other way around.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Kira. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Goldilocks324 wins about 3.8 more games per 100 on it.
Goldilocks324's champion pool is 19+ heroes wide and the top three are only 30% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Goldilocks324 is at 352 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 922 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Recent form is below the career line

insights.title: Goldilocks324 is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 50%. Past 32: 33%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 6 of 12 short games vs 5 of 15 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Cuban brings out Goldilocks324's best
insights.finding: Goldilocks324's record alongside Cuban Noobster is 55% over 243 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 3 pentakills in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 19 (plus 2 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Goldilocks324 has receipts.
